articles.mainIdea: Lucid Air Achieves Longest Range at NAF Winter Test 2026
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Lucid Air Achieves Longest Range at NAF Winter Test 2026. Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LCID), maker of the world's most advanced electric vehicles, announced that one of its vehicles achieved the longest range in this year's Norges Automobil-Forbund (NAF) Winter Test "El Prix." A Lucid Air Grand Touring1 covered an incredible range of 520 kilometers during the coldest NAF Winter Test ever recorded, with temperatures dropping to minus 31 degrees Celsius on snowy roads.
